 Vivo Y32 5G brings a 120Hz display and 44W charging to the budget segment
 By 
 Mudassir Kamran

 Vivo Y32 5G brings a 120Hz display and 44W charging to the budget segment (Image via Vivo) 
 The Vivo Y32 5G has entered the budget smartphone segment with features aimed at users who want a reliable device for everyday use. The new handset brings improvements that could appeal to buyers looking for a balance between affordability and convenience.

 With growing competition in the budget 5G market, Vivo is looking to make its latest Y-series phone stand out. Here is what you need to know about its launch and key highlights.

 The Vivo Y32 5G targets buyers who want a budget smartphone with dependable everyday performance. Its hardware focuses on battery endurance and durability, making it suitable for users who spend long hours away from a charger.
 The phone also includes stereo speakers for a better entertainment experience. A side-mounted fingerprint scanner provides convenient access, while NFC support enables compatible contactless functions. Its expandable storage offers additional room for photos and other files.

 Vivo Y32 5G price: Will it launch in India?
 The Y32 5G has launched in selected countries as of now. The 4GB RAM and 128GB storage variant is the base model, while higher-memory options cost more.
 However, Vivo has not confirmed an India launch date or local pricing yet. Indian buyers will need to wait for an official announcement to know whether the smartphone will arrive in the country and at what price.
